subject: Integration cost model + ops landing zone for Private hosting
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Akira Tanaka <akira.tanaka@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-28T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Integration cost model + ops landing zone for Private hosting

Team —

Acme Health is asking for a tight feasibility check: they want a Private deployment (VPC + optional on-prem data plane) and have asked us to surface a first-pass integration cost model, ops landing-zone requirements, and any policy exceptions we anticipate. They’re on a procurement timeline and want our inputs for their internal review by Dec 10.

Top asks:
- High-level cost model (infra + one-time integration + recurring ops) — rough numbers in an attached sheet.
- Landing-zone checklist: networking, KMS/HSM, logging/audit, disaster recovery, deployment cadence.
- Any compliance exceptions (data residency, offline access, audit logs retention) we expect to request from them.
- A 2–3 headcount estimate (SRE/infra/PM) for 6–12 month pilot support.

I attached a starter workbook (infra_cost_model_v1.xlsx) — please update and return by EOD Dec 7 so I can consolidate for procurement. Akira — feel free to correct any assumptions.

Thanks,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: infra_cost_model_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, stub)

From: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Akira Tanaka <akira.tanaka@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T10:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Integration cost model + ops landing zone for Private hosting

Thanks Evelyn — I started filling out the workbook and added a quick assumptions tab. A few technical clarifications before I push a more complete sheet:

1) KMS/HSM: do we need a customer-managed HSM for key operations (no access by Redwood), or will a customer-managed key in their cloud KMS be sufficient? If HSM is required we should add a hardware + ops line to the one-time cost.

2) Network topology: are they expecting a fully air-gapped on-prem option or a hybrid VPC with peering/VPN? The latter changes egress/hour expectations and NAT device costs.

3) Monitoring/audit retention: default Redwood retains trace logs 90 days; if Acme wants 7 years we need to call out storage + search cost (and potential slowdowns for large-scale queries).

I attached an updated workbook: infra_cost_model_v1.xlsx (tab: dev-estimates). I also added a small mitigation list if they request HSM-only access.

—Dev
Dev Patel
Staff Engineer, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Akira Tanaka <akira.tanaka@acmehealth.com>, Procurement <procure@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T08:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Integration cost model + ops landing zone for Private hosting

Evelyn / team —

A few procurement/compliance notes from my side:
- Acme’s standard SOW asks for 5 year log retention in certain scopes; we should identify which logs are in/out to avoid surprise costs.
- They will want a data processing addendum and possibly an on-site audit clause — legal will want to see a clear scope for the pilot.
- Please add a line in the workbook for ‘audit evidence collection’ (timeboxed professional services).

Akira — can procurement confirm whether the on-prem node will be in their network with direct physical control or in a co-lo? That affects our indemnity and install-window planning.

I’ll flag finance for any nonstandard billing terms if the one-time integration exceeds $75k.

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Akira Tanaka <akira.tanaka@acmehealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T14:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Integration cost model + ops landing zone for Private hosting

Hi all — thanks for the fast follow. A few clarifications from Acme:
- We will be a hybrid deployment: primary data plane in our on-prem DC (co-lo), with control plane in your hosted control plane (private control plane model). The on-prem node will be on our VLAN behind a firewall.
- KMS: we require customer-controlled keys and prefer an HSM-backed KMS for PHI scopes.
- Audit retention: for the pilot we need 3 years, but enterprise rollout will require up to 7 years for some records.
- Install window: we have maintenance windows on weekends only (Sat 0200–0600 local).

We'll review the updated workbook tonight and return with procurement redlines.

—Akira
Akira Tanaka
Lead Engineering Manager, Platform
Acme Health

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
To: Akira Tanaka <akira.tanaka@acmehealth.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-07T11:07:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Integration cost model + ops landing zone for Private hosting

Team and Akira —

Thanks for the clarifications — that hybrid approach matches what we expected. Quick decisions from our side:
- KMS/HSM: we'll plan for an HSM-backed customer-managed KMS as an option (add to one-time integration + ops runbook).
- Retention: we'll model 3 years baseline and include optional 7-year tier as an add-on line.
- Install window: schedule will be weekend windows only; SRE will need a documented runbook + on-site remote hands agreement with the co-lo.

Next steps (action owners):
- Dev: finalize cost model with HSM + egress assumptions (due EOD Dec 9).
- Marcus: produce a short landing_zone_diagram.png showing network demarcation and logging paths (due Dec 9).
- Lauren: prepare a procurement/contract bulleted list to show to Acme procurement (due Dec 9).
- I will consolidate and send to Acme procurement on Dec 10.

If anyone sees a blocker to the above timeline, flag now.

—Evelyn

All — attached is the landing_zone_diagram.png (high-level). A couple of architecture caveats to call out to Acme:
- If they want strict HSM isolation with no network key export, certain live-rekeying workflows will need a maintenance window longer than 4 hours; we should spell that out.
- For 3-year retention at our search performance SLAs, add an indexing tier (see infra cost model tab: index-storage).
- Remote hands: recommend we budget for 3 remote-hands events during pilot (one-time ops line).

I also added a brief PDF with my RD notes (rd-comments.pdf) that explains where we’ll likely ask exceptions (example: rate-limited backup replay for privacy-preserving audits).

Happy to sync for 20 minutes tomorrow if we want to review before Dec 10 submission.

—Marcus
